0022600109.text: The Mavericks host the Spurs in Dallas' third game of the 2026-27 season, with Dallas at 1-1, on a one-game winning streak, and third in the Southwest, one game back, while San Antonio is 0-2 and on a two-game losing streak, fifth in the Southwest and two games back. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin, Cooper Flagg, Dereck Lively II, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic, and Kyrie Irving, Max Christie, Morez Johnson Jr. and Zaccharie Risacher are listed as day-to-day, game-time decisions. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance and Tobias Harris, and the teams have not met yet this season, while the Mavericks lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
